up: Return a table of bioactivity rows for compounds tested against the human target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2835. For each row, provide the following columns: the IC50 value in nM (exact values only, excluding NULLs or relations other than '='), the canonical SMILES string, the compound key from the compound records, the PubMed ID or DOI (preferring PubMed ID when both are present), the assay description, and the target details (ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and organism). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs to retrieve the required columns. Return all matching rows without limiting the number of results.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.standard_value AS ic50_value,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2835'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
